title: RAG Explained for Beginners: Give AI Relevant Documents | Ep 45
description:
RAG Explained for Beginners: Give AI Relevant Documents. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 45 of 50

What you will learn: Retrieve relevant documents before generating an answer.
Example: answering a policy question from a company handbook.
Try it: highlight source passages used for an answer.
Remember: retrieval can still miss passages or misunderstand them.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
Subscribe to @Techat60 for practical AI tutorials.
